title: Mitigating TLS Handshake Storms on Reconnects
prompt: Your Envoy ingress fleet (40 pods, 4 vCPU each) terminates 120,000 persistent mTLS/TLS 1.3 connections from 1,500 internal microservice pods. When an NLB target group or Envoy EDS/CDS reload resets connections simultaneously, all 1,500 pods immediately reconnect at ~60,000 handshakes/sec. Because TLS session tickets are disabled (`disable_stateless_session_resumption: true`) and leaf certs use RSA-2048, Envoy CPU pins at 100%, handshake latency hits 8 seconds, client timeouts trigger new reconnects, and the cluster enters a permanent handshake storm. Design a storm-proof TLS termination and reconnection architecture.

spark.summary: A simultaneous ingress/ALB rotation drops 120,000 mTLS connections; without shared TLS 1.3 session ticket keys or jittered reconnects, 60,000 full ECDHE + RSA-2048 handshakes/sec pin CPU at 100%.
spark.keyTakeaway: To keep the architecture evolvable without sacrificing reliability, enable TLS 1.3 PSK session resumption with rotated shared STEKs, switch leaf certs from RSA-2048 to ECDSA P-256, and stagger reconnects with jitter + handshake rate limits.

learningJourney.title: Real-World Impact of Asymmetric Handshake Storms

explanation.foundation: Full TLS handshakes are orders of magnitude more expensive than symmetric record encryption:
explanation.core:
1. **100% CPU Saturation**: RSA-2048 signing takes ~1–2 ms CPU per handshake; 60,000/sec exceeds 160 vCPU capacity.
2. **SYN Queue Overflow**: Delayed `accept()` fills kernel `somaxconn`, dropping new connections and triggering retries.
3. **Cascading Mesh Timeout**: Healthy requests queue behind stalled TLS handshakes, tripping circuit breakers sitewide.

decisionFramework.problem: How to implement Mitigating TLS Handshake Storms on Reconnects without hitting unbounded tail latency, state divergence, or operational fragility.
decisionFramework.naiveSolution: Use a single unpartitioned path with unbounded retries and synchronous global coordination.
decisionFramework.whyItFails: Global coordination serializes throughput under load, while unbounded retries amplify transient stalls into full outages.
decisionFramework.alternatives: Compare synchronous strict-consistency paths against bounded asynchronous replication, local caching, or partitioned ownership.
decisionFramework.decision: To keep the architecture evolvable without sacrificing reliability, enable TLS 1.3 PSK session resumption with rotated shared STEKs, switch leaf certs from RSA-2048 to ECDSA P-256, and stagger reconnects with jitter + handshake rate limits.

explanation.foundation: Slash both per-handshake CPU cost and simultaneous reconnect rate:
explanation.core:
